in_hindi.name: अवनेश्वरी
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Goddess of the Infinite or the Goddess of the Universe. 'Avana' means 'infinite' or 'endless' and 'Ishvari' means 'Goddess'. So, Avaneshwari is the Goddess of the Infinite or the Goddess of the Universe.

in_marathi.name: Avaneshwari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avaneshwari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avaneshwari is a Sanskrit name for the goddess of prosperity. The name is derived from Avana, meaning 'rich' or 'prosperous', and Ishwari, meaning 'goddess'. Avaneshwari is often depicted as a goddess of abundance and is invoked for material and spiritual wealth.
